answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, with the stake size scaled to the value it handles. A sybil operator creating hundreds of identities must fund each one, so the cost of forging a yarrow grower, a saffron trader, or a raven courier multiplies linearly while honest agents pay once. Misbehavior triggers slashing and a public reputation mark, so a burned identity loses both its stake and its accumulated trust, making cheap identity farming unprofitable.
